_recommendation: Pin every image to an immutable digest (@sha256:...). Tag-only references like 'busybox:latest' or 'alpine:3' are mutable — same name, different bytes over time, drifting CVE attribution. Pin form (1) below is the most ergonomic: simple-string + digest pin in one line, Dependabot-updatable.
_comment: For Dependabot automated updates, use simple string format for 'image' field. Dependabot cannot parse structured object format. See examples/dependabot.example.yml

containers._note: PREFERRED: simple string with digest pin. Reproducible AND Dependabot-updatable in one line.
containers.name: alpine-pinned-string

containers._note: ALSO PREFERRED: structured form when you need registry/auth separation. Same digest-pinned posture; Dependabot can't auto-update — Renovate or manual.
containers.name: alpine-pinned-structured

containers._note: ACCEPTABLE FALLBACK: tag-only. Mutable — CVE attribution drifts whenever the registry republishes the tag. Use only for ad-hoc scans or until you can wire up digest discovery.
containers.name: busybox-latest

containers._note: Private registry example — auth secrets resolved by the calling workflow, not stored here.
containers.name: ghcr-runner
